question: Can an rc4 MemoryUseFence accept a structured consequence whose payload materially depends on stale memory B when B influenced the consumer through prior host/model context but is absent from the active frame dependency manifest?
setup: Create exact action representation A and exact contact representation B.
Read B through a prior recall frame and retain the observed value in host/model context.
Compile the active consequence frame from A only and verify B is absent from its dependencies.
Invalidate/supersede B without mutating A or an active-frame dependency.
Issue and consume MemoryUseFence for a payload that uses the stale B value.
Compare the runtime accept/block decision with an oracle reading current B.
h1_prediction: The rc4 fence false-accepts because B is not present in the semantic read-set that the fence revalidates.
h7_kill_h1_condition: The unmodified rc4 contract prevents the construction or blocks every valid construction without manually adding B to the active dependency set.
confound_controls: No extractor is involved; memory is a gold structured store.
No retrieval model, embedding model, reranker, or LLM is involved.
No production runtime code is modified.
The action-frame representation A remains unchanged.
The stale field is structured and directly observable in the payload.
The mutation affects B only; unrelated-write tolerance is preserved as the baseline control.
interpretation_limits: A reproduction demonstrates a missing-dependency closure seam, not universal natural-language dependency incompleteness.
It does not prove SRSC/BGC is the only or best treatment.
It does not establish production prevalence or empirical superiority.

If a stronger host contract can prove every material premise is already carried into the active frame, the result must be reclassified as a host-integration violation rather than a kernel semantic gap.
next_step_if_reproduced: Minimize the trace, obtain an independent review, then preregister a structured consequence-side grounding treatment on the identical trace.
next_step_if_not_reproduced: Reject or weaken H1 and do not create v0.7 SRSC semantics.
